policy: Operator-specific night brands and explicit night descriptions. N alone is not a night-service indicator. Availability follows GTFS calendars, exceptions and service times, including times above 24:00. Missing geometry is never drawn or animated. Network absence does not prove that a city has no night services.

cities.name: Barcelona
cities.coverage: TMB, FGC, TRAM (Trambaix y Trambesòs) y autobuses metropolitanos de AMB, incluido el Nitbus. No incluye todos los operadores del área metropolitana.

cities.name: Madrid
cities.coverage: Metro, EMT y Metro Ligero. Cercanías se encuentra en la vista nacional de Renfe.

cities.name: Sevilla
cities.coverage: TUSSAM, Metro y Consorcio del Área de Sevilla.

cities.name: Zaragoza
cities.coverage: Avanza y tranvía. Comprueba la vigencia del calendario de cada operador.
